# Gunsmith Expansion - sprite recipes, written by art/recipes.py. Do not edit by hand.
# The mod may not ship the game's sprites (modding code of conduct), even modified:
# the sprites below are rebuilt in game (src/SpriteRecipes.cs) from the player's own
# copy of the vanilla sprites listed as sources. No vanilla pixel colour is stored.
#
# source <id> <atlas|icon> <atlas path or -> <name> <width> <height> <hash>
# sprite <key> <width> <height>
# own <index> <rrggbbaa>             a colour of the mod's own (outlines, stencils...)
# table <n> <from>><to> ...           colour mapping (vanilla colour > game palette colour)
# row <tokens>                        one per pixel row, top first:
#   .   empty        .N  N empty      _  inventory cell fill (black, alpha 3)
#   oI  own colour I                  S:X,Y  pixel (X, Y) of source S, as is
#   S:X,Y/T  same, through colour table T
